{{Quote|I'm afraid we must make do with probe droids and scout ships to make regular patrols of the Garia system given the system's lack of suitable hiding spots.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Trep Reskan]] in a report to General [[Natara]]|<ref name="FBS" />}}
The '''Garia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]], in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="FBS" /> The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garia]],<ref name="PB" /> which was capable of [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] production as well as a degree of manufacturing capabilities.<ref name="FBS" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Garia was the site of a [[Battle of Garia|battle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The Republic staged an invasion of the planet, which was held by the Separatists.<ref name="PB" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] staging area in the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Permits were required for entry into the system, with strict penalties enacted against any violators. Security in the system was augmented by constant [[Picket ship/Legends|picket ship]] patrols and [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] stations that monitored the outer edges of the system.<ref name="FBS" />

Unlike their efforts in the [[Bacrana system/Legends|Bacrana]], [[Rehn system/Legends|Rehn]], and [[Skone system/Legends|Skone systems]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Brak Sector Force]] was unable to establish a [[listening post]] in the system due to a lack of suitable sites. Instead, the Alliance used regular [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] and [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessel]] sweeps to obtain information on Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] movements in the system.<ref name="FBS" />
